models.visible: sceneState.mode ~= 3 and sceneState.flash <= 0 and (sceneState.moving == 0 or sceneState.ui > 0 or sceneState.mode > 0)
sceneState.mode == 0 and sceneState.ui == 0 and sceneState.moving == 1 and sin(sceneState.gait) >= 0
sceneState.mode == 0 and sceneState.ui == 0 and sceneState.moving == 1 and sin(sceneState.gait) < 0

on_frame.condition: sceneState.input.X and not sceneState.menuHeld and sceneState.mode == 0

assignments.name: moving
assignments.value: (sceneState.dx ~= 0 or sceneState.dy ~= 0) and sceneState.actionTimer <= 0 and 1 or 0

assignments.name: damage
assignments.value: sceneState.distance <= sceneState.range and (sceneState.distance < 2.3 and 7 or 5) or 0
